coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Duolingo

Dear Hiring Manager,

With half a billion learners, Duolingo needs backend services that stay fast and reliable as traffic grows. I ran into that problem at Lumen Payments, where the payment status API was slow on its hottest reads. I moved those reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and brought p99 latency down from 480 ms to 120 ms.

As a Senior Software Engineer there, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot on Kafka, handling about 40 million events a day. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, so I know how to take ownership from design through production. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews, and I work with Datadog and AWS (EC2, RDS, SQS, S3). Your ad says the Ads team owns ad serving and works cross-functionally with product, design and data science. I haven't built ad systems, but I've shipped event-driven, high-traffic services in Java, Kotlin and Python and I learn new domains quickly. My B.Sc. in Computer Science from Waterloo and my AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (2024) back the fundamentals you list.

After a planned career break to care for a family member, I'm returning to full-time engineering with current skills. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help your backend team keep shipping, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Software Engineer II, Backend, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Duolingo Hiring Team,

You're looking for someone to develop, release and maintain backend services, and that's the work I did at Lumen Payments, where I designed and ran a Kotlin settlement service processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I bring 11 years of backend experience in Java, Kotlin and Python, a Computer Science degree from the University of Waterloo, and a record of leading a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month move from a monolith to 6 services. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available to start a conversation any weekday this month and can begin a new role on short notice.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
